title: Document local satellite onboarding routes in the architecture API table
outcome: The architecture API reference includes the local enrollment, verification and verification-report routes with links to the onboarding brief.
acceptance: The architecture local API table documents POST /api/federation/peers/{id}/enroll, POST /api/federation/peers/{id}/verify and GET /api/federation/peers/{id}/verification and links to the satellite onboarding brief.
The reference describes relevant mismatch, stale/incomplete and missing-report responses and states verification never activates a satellite.
